title: Special Episode: ‘An Obituary for the Land’

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: I'm good.
sentences.zh: 我很好。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你呢？

sentences.en: I'm just so happy to hear your voice.
sentences.zh: 听到你的声音我真是太高兴了。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Bianca Gaver.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是比安卡·盖弗。

sentences.en: I'm an audio producer here on The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我是《每日新闻》的一名音频制作人。

sentences.en: Oh my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Oh my God, what are you seeing?
sentences.zh: 天哪，你看到了什么？

sentences.en: Well, right now I'm just, there's no windows around me, but I haven't seen the sky in like a week.
sentences.zh: 嗯，现在我周围没有窗户，但我已经有一周没见过天空了。

sentences.en: And I happened to be working from the West Coast when the fires started.
sentences.zh: 火灾刚开始时，我正好在西海岸工作。

sentences.en: It's like a haze.
sentences.zh: 就像笼罩在烟雾中一样。

sentences.en: I've never experienced anything like it.
sentences.zh: 我从未经历过这样的事情。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: What do you see?
sentences.zh: 你看到了什么？

sentences.en: And to be honest, I was feeling a lot of anxiety.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我感到非常焦虑。

sentences.en: In fact, last night was the first time we've seen the stars.
sentences.zh: 事实上，昨晚是我们第一次看到星星。

sentences.en: It's a very claustrophobic feeling, not being able to see the sky.
sentences.zh: 看不见天空的感觉让人非常压抑。

sentences.en: And the other day, I woke up in the smoke, and this phrase popped into my head.
sentences.zh: 前几天，我在烟雾中醒来，脑子里突然冒出了一个短语。

sentences.en: An obituary for the land.
sentences.zh: 为这片土地写一篇讣告。

sentences.en: And then I just immediately wrote to you.
sentences.zh: 然后我立刻就给你写了信。

sentences.en: So the subject was checking in.
sentences.zh: 邮件的主题是“问候”。

sentences.en: I sent an email to my friend, Terry Tempest WilliaMs.
sentences.zh: 我给我的朋友特里·坦佩斯特·威廉姆斯发了一封邮件。
zh_words: 特里·坦佩斯特·威廉姆斯

sentences.en: You said, Terry, would you write an obituary for the land?
sentences.zh: 你当时说：“特里，你愿意为这片土地写一篇讣告吗？”

sentences.en: She's a poet.
sentences.zh: 她是一位诗人。

sentences.en: It just, it undid me.
sentences.zh: 这让我深受触动。

sentences.en: She lives in Utah, and she's written about the West for decades.
sentences.zh: 她住在犹他州，几十年来一直致力于书写西部。

sentences.en: Nothing comes easily out here, you know?
sentences.zh: 在这里，没有什么事情是容易的，你知道吗？

sentences.en: It's a dramatic landscape, and it's dramatic weather.
sentences.zh: 这里的地貌很壮观，天气也变幻莫测。

sentences.en: And so after that email, we got on this phone call, and we talked about fire, and grief, and fear,
sentences.zh: 在那封邮件之后，我们通了电话，聊到了火灾、悲伤和恐惧，

sentences.en: and the obituary she wrote.
sentences.zh: 以及她写的那篇讣告。

sentences.en: Our family, I don't know if you knew this, but we were almost taken by fire on my father's 75th birthday.
sentences.zh: 我们的家人，不知道你知不知道，在我父亲75岁生日那天，我们差点被大火吞没。

sentences.en: We all hiked into Granite Park Chalet in Glacier.
sentences.zh: 我们当时徒步进入了冰川国家公园的花岗岩公园木屋。

sentences.en: I think there were 18 of us.
sentences.zh: 我想我们当时有18个人。

sentences.en: And we knew there were fires far away, but everything was safe.
sentences.zh: 我们知道远处有火灾，但一切看起来都很安全。

sentences.en: We had, you know, we were staying at the chalet, and I had had a dream the night before of bats coming out of the forest in a spiral.
sentences.zh: 我们当时住在木屋里，前一天晚上我做了一个梦，梦见蝙蝠从森林里盘旋而出。

sentences.en: And my brother and I were sitting on this rock outcropping, and I saw this spiral of bats coming out of the foreSt.
sentences.zh: 我和哥哥坐在岩石露头上，我真的看到了那群盘旋着飞出森林的蝙蝠。

sentences.en: And I said, Dan, we have to get out of here.
sentences.zh: 我说：“丹，我们必须离开这里。”

sentences.en: And within an hour, the fires were all around us.
sentences.zh: 不到一个小时，大火就包围了我们。

sentences.en: And then they got everyone out from the campgrounds.
sentences.zh: 然后他们把露营地里的所有人都撤了出来。

sentences.en: I think there were 24 of us, put us inside the chalet in a circle and said, the fire's going to come.
sentences.zh: 我想我们当时有24个人，被带进木屋围成一圈，他们说：“火要来了。”

sentences.en: It's going to roar over the chalet.
sentences.zh: “它会咆哮着越过木屋。”

sentences.en: The windows are going to shatter.
sentences.zh: “窗户会震碎。”

sentences.en: You won't be able to breathe.
sentences.zh: “你们会无法呼吸。”

sentences.en: All the oxygen will be sucked out, and then it will go over, and hopefully we'll be fine.
sentences.zh: “所有的氧气都会被抽干，然后火势会过去，希望我们能平安无事。”

sentences.en: They really thought we were going to die.
sentences.zh: 他们当时真的以为我们要死了。

sentences.en: The fire sounded like a train wreck.
sentences.zh: 火声听起来就像火车失事一样。

sentences.en: Our eyebrows were singed.
sentences.zh: 我们的眉毛都被烧焦了。

sentences.en: Our eyes were red.
sentences.zh: 我们的眼睛通红。

sentences.en: We couldn't breathe, and it literally, as the fire came roaring up, it, by some fluke, it went around us and blew up over us, and we survived.
sentences.zh: 我们无法呼吸，就在大火咆哮着冲过来的时候，奇迹般地，它绕过了我们，从我们头顶掠过，我们活了下来。

sentences.en: And then it just burned all around us all night.
sentences.zh: 然后整晚大火都在我们周围燃烧。

sentences.en: It creates a mosaic.
sentences.zh: 它形成了一种马赛克般的景象。

sentences.en: It burns, and then it leaps.
sentences.zh: 它燃烧，然后跳跃。

sentences.en: So it doesn't take everything.
sentences.zh: 所以它并没有摧毁一切。

sentences.en: And when we walked out in the morning, we had to walk out, I think, like 14 miles.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上我们走出来时，我想我们走了大约14英里。

sentences.en: The grizzly bears walked out with us just below the hillside.
sentences.zh: 灰熊就在山坡下和我们一起走出来。

sentences.en: Being in a fire like that, I mean, a real forest fire in the mountains, like what is happening.
sentences.zh: 身处那样的大火中，我是说，在山里经历真正的森林大火，那感觉真是难以言喻。

sentences.en: If I hadn't felt that force, I mean, the energy that is being expended right now, I mean, I think it's a wonder we're not all in bed, because we are not neutral bodies.
sentences.zh: 如果我没有感受到那种力量，我是说，现在正在释放的能量，我想我们没全都瘫倒在床就是个奇迹，因为我们并非无动于衷的躯体。

sentences.en: I mean, we are feeling that.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我们能感受到这一切。

sentences.en: And, you know, I just went outside, and all of the patio furniture is covered in ash.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我刚才走到外面，所有的庭院家具都覆盖着灰烬。

sentences.en: And, you know, you just think, that ash, you know, those are trees, those are bodies, that's fur, that's feathers, it's, it's, it's everything.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你会想，那些灰烬，那是树木，那是生命，那是皮毛，那是羽毛，那是……那是万物。

sentences.en: And it's, you know, we're covered in it.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我们身上也沾满了灰烬。

sentences.en: And anyone who says they're fine, they are dead to this world that is really dying.
sentences.zh: 任何说自己没事的人，对这个正在死去的现实世界来说，他们已经麻木了。

sentences.en: And, and grief, I feel like it's a raven on my shoulder.
sentences.zh: 悲伤，我觉得它就像停在我肩上的一只乌鸦。

sentences.en: I, you know, I just walk with it every day.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我每天都带着它同行。

sentences.en: And that is the truth.
sentences.zh: 这就是真相。

sentences.en: I'm wondering what other fires you've been in, and what you saw happen to the land after the fire.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你还经历过哪些火灾，以及火灾后你看到这片土地发生了什么变化。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: You know, as a Westerner, you grow up with fire.
sentences.zh: 你知道，作为一个西部人，你是伴随着火灾长大的。

sentences.en: I have walked through many burnt forests in Idaho and in the West looking for morels, because wherever there is fire, the next season is going to be a haven for gathering morels.
sentences.zh: 我在爱达荷州和西部许多被烧毁的森林里走过，寻找羊肚菌，因为无论哪里有火，下一个季节都会成为采集羊肚菌的天堂。

sentences.en: Another fire that I remember vividly was the summer of 1988 in Yellowstone National Park.
sentences.zh: 我记忆犹新的一场火灾是1988年夏天在黄石国家公园发生的。

sentences.en: And in that instance, one third of the park was burned.
sentences.zh: 在那次事件中，三分之一的公园被烧毁了。

sentences.en: And in many instances, new regeneration started within days.
sentences.zh: 但在许多地方，几天之内就开始了新的再生。

sentences.en: I remember the next summer returning.
sentences.zh: 我记得第二年夏天回去的时候。

sentences.en: And it was just a cacophony of new life, new birds, new plants.
sentences.zh: 那里充满了新生命的声音，新的鸟儿，新的植物。

sentences.en: And it was shoulder high in fireweed, which are these magnificent fuchsia flowers on tall stalks.
sentences.zh: 柳兰长到了肩膀那么高，那是一种长在长茎上的壮丽紫红色花朵。

sentences.en: And even now, you know, with fires in Montana and Wyoming and Colorado and Utah, it's a lodgepole pine, and they have cones called serotonous cones.
sentences.zh: 即使是现在，你知道，蒙大拿州、怀俄明州、科罗拉多州和犹他州的火灾中，那是扭叶松，它们有种叫“浆果松果”的球果。

sentences.en: If you see those on the ground, you can't open them.
sentences.zh: 如果你在地上看到它们，你是打不开的。

sentences.en: They're just tight, and they're spiky.
sentences.zh: 它们紧闭着，长满尖刺。

sentences.en: But when they feel heat in the tree, when the flames come up,
sentences.zh: 但当它们在树上感受到热量，当火焰升起时，

sentences.en: they feel the heat.
sentences.zh: 它们感受到了热量。

sentences.en: And immediately, before the tree is consumed, they open up and the seeds drop before the fire has even started to run.
sentences.zh: 在树木被烧毁之前，它们会立即打开，种子在火势蔓延之前就已经落下。

sentences.en: So before those trees are consumed, the seeds have already been dropped and have already been placed in the ground.
sentences.zh: 所以，在那些树木被烧毁之前，种子就已经落下并埋入土中了。

sentences.en: Isn't that amazing?
sentences.zh: 这难道不神奇吗？

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: That gives me hope.
sentences.zh: 这给了我希望。

sentences.en: I mean, isn't...
sentences.zh: 我是说，难道不……

sentences.en: I just find that that is such a beautiful adaptation.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这是一种非常美丽的适应方式。

sentences.en: So I just, you know, for me, I think, okay, that is both fact, you know, science, and metaphor.
sentences.zh: 所以，对我来说，我想，好吧，这既是事实，你知道，科学，也是隐喻。

sentences.en: You know, so right now, we can't even know what is opening in us, but something is.
sentences.zh: 你知道，所以现在，我们甚至不知道我们内心正在开启什么，但确实有什么正在开启。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So I gave you this assignment, and you went with it.
sentences.zh: 所以我给了你这个任务，而你完成了它。

sentences.en: Do you feel comfortable reading some of what you wrote today?
sentences.zh: 你愿意读一下你今天写的部分内容吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I do.
sentences.zh: 是的，我愿意。

sentences.en: Put this down and get it.
sentences.zh: 放下这个，把它拿过来。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Bianca, what part do you want me to read?
sentences.zh: 比安卡，你想让我读哪一部分？

sentences.en: Um, maybe toward the end, or the part where you directly address the obituary.
sentences.zh: 嗯，也许是结尾部分，或者你直接提到讣告的那一部分。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: The obituary will be short.
sentences.zh: 讣告会很短。

sentences.en: The time came, and they died to the old ways of being.
sentences.zh: 时候到了，它们对旧有的生存方式说再见。

sentences.en: Good riddance.
sentences.zh: 滚吧。

sentences.en: It was time, a terminal disease, where humans put themselves at the center of the universe, and in so doing, have been dead to the world that is alive.
sentences.zh: 是时候了，这是一种绝症，人类将自己置于宇宙的中心，并因此对这个充满活力的世界视而不见。

sentences.en: To the power of these burning, illuminated Western lands, who have shaped our character,
sentences.zh: 致这些燃烧的、被照亮的西部土地的力量，它们塑造了我们的性格，

sentences.en: inspired our souls.
sentences.zh: 启迪了我们的灵魂。

sentences.en: And restored our belief in what is beautiful and enduring.
sentences.zh: 并恢复了我们对美好与永恒事物的信念。

sentences.en: I will never write your obituary.
sentences.zh: 我永远不会为你写讣告。

sentences.en: Because even as you burn, you are throwing down seeds that will sprout and flower.
sentences.zh: 因为即使在你燃烧时，你也在播撒种子，它们终将发芽开花。

sentences.en: Trees will grow, and forests will rise again as living testaments to how one survives change.
sentences.zh: 树木会生长，森林会再次崛起，成为生命如何度过变迁的活生生的见证。

sentences.en: Let this be a humble tribute, an exaltation, an homage, an open-hearted eulogy to all we are losing to fire, to floods, to hurricanes, and tornadoes,
sentences.zh: 让这成为一份谦卑的致敬、一种赞美、一种敬意、一份发自内心的悼词，献给我们在火灾、洪水、飓风、龙卷风中失去的一切，

sentences.en: and the invisible virus that has called us all home and brought us to our knees.
sentences.zh: 以及那场召唤我们所有人回家并让我们跪倒在地的隐形病毒。

sentences.en: We are not the only species that lives and loves and breathes on this planet called Earth.
sentences.zh: 我们并不是这颗名为地球的行星上唯一生存、相爱和呼吸的物种。

sentences.en: May we raise a fistful of ash to all the lives lost that it holds.
sentences.zh: 愿我们捧起一把灰烬，献给所有逝去的生命。

sentences.en: Grief is love.
sentences.zh: 悲伤即是爱。

sentences.en: How can we hold this grief without holding each other?
sentences.zh: 如果不互相扶持，我们该如何承受这份悲伤？

sentences.en: I will mark my heart with an X made of ash that says,
sentences.zh: 我将在心上用灰烬画一个X，上面写着：

sentences.en: The power to restore life resides here.
sentences.zh: 恢复生命的力量就在这里。

sentences.en: The future of our species will be decided here, not by facts, but by love and loss.
sentences.zh: 我们物种的未来将在这里决定，不是由事实，而是由爱与失去。

sentences.en: Let us cry every day like rain in the desert.
sentences.zh: 让我们每天都像沙漠里的雨一样哭泣吧。

sentences.en: And on my heart, I pledge of allegiance to the only home I will ever know.
sentences.zh: 在我的心上，我向我唯一知道的家园宣誓效忠。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you for asking.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你的邀请。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了一群自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场伤痕累累、混乱不堪，有时又令人兴奋的斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在《地铁》的最新一集中，我和莎拉·凯尼格将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 在任何你收听播客的地方订阅我们。
